name: vwap_volume_divergence_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus
thesis: When price moves away from VWAP but volume is declining (price-volume divergence), the move lacks institutional conviction and is likely to reverse. Conversely, when price moves toward VWAP on increasing volume, the reversion has institutional backing and is likely to follow through. This exploits the fact that retail-driven moves often occur on declining volume (exhaustion), while institutional moves show increasing volume (accumulation/distribution). The edge exists because most VWAP strategies only look at price deviation, ignoring the volume profile of the deviation. Adding volume confirmation filters out low-quality reversion signals.
mechanism: VWAP is the institutional execution benchmark. When spot deviates significantly from session VWAP, algorithmic execution engines increase order flow to mean-revert their fills toward VWAP. This creates measurable gravitational pull, especially during lower-volume mid-session periods when fewer competing flows are present.

conditions: OBV_slope < 0 AND abs(OBV_slope) declining over last 5 bars
OBV_slope > 0 AND abs(OBV_slope) declining over last 5 bars

exit.signal_exit: exit if volume surges 3x+ in direction away from VWAP (institutional confirmation of move)

filters.volume_filter: bar volume must be > 0.5x 10-bar SMA (not dead tape)

weaknesses: Volume pattern interpretation is subjective — declining volume during a move can also indicate absorption, not exhaustion
OBV slope over 10 bars is noisy and can give conflicting signals with raw volume slope
In illiquid stocks, volume patterns are unreliable — hence the tight liquidity filter is essential
prior_art: Price-volume divergence is classical TA (Granville, 'New Key to Stock Market Profits'). On-Balance Volume is from Granville (1963). Combining divergence specifically with VWAP deviation is less documented. Wyckoff method uses similar supply/demand logic with volume confirmation.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
